title: The Last Machine Again
author: Jude Pemberton
blurb: Odile Pemberton, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
